message: Weather fetched successfully (live snapshot from /api/v1/weather/current, en)
_NEW_FIELDS_NOTE: Same contract as the bn file; this is the en variant. The live /api/v1/weather/current endpoint ignores Accept-Language and always returns bn text/units/digits, so this file is derived by swapping in typen for condition text, fixed English unit abbreviations, ASCII digits, and date/weekday computed from step_start — everything else (field set, daily/steps counts, nulls) matches the real response.
